evidence.name: Nights spent at tourist accommodation establishments by month and NUTS 2 region (from 2020 onwards)
evidence.schema_observation: dims freq(A) c_resid(TOTAL) nace_r2(I551-I553 only; no I551/I552/I553 breakdown at NUTS 2) month(TOTAL,M01..M12) unit(NR) geo(EL,EL62) time(2020..2025); 156 values, no status flags; dataset updated 2026-10-20.
evidence.note: Monthly EL62 nights exist from 2020 (the 2026-09-24 finding concerned tour_occ_nim, which has no EL62). Cross-checks: EL62 annual TOTAL 2022=16,512,634 and 2023=19,762,799 equal tour_occ_nin2; EL 2023 monthly values equal tour_occ_nim. Top-3-month share of EL reproduces dashboard TOUR_SOE_02 for EL 2021-2023 exactly (70.40, 58.73, 56.86). EL62 top-3 share 2023 = 63.81 % (dashboard 71.08). tour_occ_nin3m and tour_ce_omn3 return HTTP 404 (no monthly NUTS 3).

evidence.name: Short-stay accommodation offered via online platforms by month and NUTS 1/2 region (guest nights)
evidence.provider: Eurostat (data from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia Group)
evidence.note: Top-3-month share of EL62 platform guest nights equals dashboard TOUR_SOE_02 for EL62 in every year 2020-2023 (87.70, 82.71, 72.06, 71.08). Finding: the dashboard EL62 seasonality value is computed from online-platform nights only, while its EL value uses conventional accommodation. accessed_at is approximate (same session, after the nin2m pull).
